interpretation_caveats: single DiD per point is one observation, not a repeated interval
order and period effects are not separated by this design; LONG occupied positions 1,3,6,8 and FAST 2,4,5,7
LONG is not claimed as steady state; no FAST fit feedback
20000/100 carries the documented Ray drift characteristic; its Ray LONG-FAST difference includes that device behavior

limits: All-off point ratios apply only to sampled exposure/settings/time; no replicated environment CI or global ambient guarantee. One DiD per node cannot separate source order and period from protocol; LONG is not steady truth.
